violations.text: The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 150-400 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The equipment was moved to warewashing area to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Pico de Gallo was prepped and then placed in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep and covered. Food was moved to shallow pans and uncovered. Cooling methods reviewed with staff. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the area between the griddle and cold drawer has an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

The door to the outside, located in the ware-washing room, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024
The food prep sink was observed with an air-break. The food prep sink must have a proper air-gap. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024
